gloss: to put on and take off; to attach and detach

definitions.gloss: to put on and take off; to attach and detach
definitions.explanation: The action of attaching/putting on and removing/taking off, especially clothing, accessories, or detachable parts. Often describes the ease or method of the process.

examples.japanese: このジャケットは{着脱|ちゃくだつ}しやすい。
examples.english: This jacket is easy to put on and take off.

examples.japanese: マスクの{着脱|ちゃくだつ}は{清潔|せいけつ}な{手|て}で{行|おこな}ってください。
examples.english: Please put on and remove your mask with clean hands.

examples.japanese: このカメラのレンズは{簡単|かんたん}に{着脱|ちゃくだつ}できるので{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: This camera's lens can be easily attached and detached, which is convenient.

notes:
A compound of {着|ちゃく} (put on/attach) and {脱|だつ} (take off/remove). Used both for clothing and for detachable parts/accessories. The noun form {着脱|ちゃくだつ} is common in product descriptions where ease of use is a selling point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着脱|ちゃくだつ}が{簡単|かんたん}: easy to put on/take off
- {着脱|ちゃくだつ}しやすい: easy to attach/detach
- {着脱|ちゃくだつ}{可能|かのう}: detachable; removable
- {着脱式|ちゃくだつしき}: detachable type
- ワンタッチで{着脱|ちゃくだつ}: attach/detach with one touch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着|き}る/{脱|ぬ}ぐ: to put on/take off (clothing) — the individual verbs for each action
- {取|と}り{外|はず}す: to remove; to detach — for removing a specific part
- {装着|そうちゃく}する: to wear; to equip — focuses on the attaching/equipping action only
